name: ntr_oh_renasight_baseline_act
xsql:
SELECT 
    pos_reg.region AS Region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.period_id IN :v_prev_month_period_ids THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS Renasight_Baseline,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS Renasight_Actual
FROM xactly.xc_credit p
INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg 
    ON p.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_title_mapping pta 
    ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
INNER JOIN $framework.NATERA_TITLE_CATEGORY_MAPPING m 
    ON pta.title_name = m.title
WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
  AND (p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids OR p.period_id IN :v_prev_month_period_ids)
  AND m.category = 'OH' 
  AND p.credit_type_name = 'Renasight'
  AND (:p_region = 'ALL' OR pos_reg.region IN (:p_region))
GROUP BY pos_reg.region
ORDER BY Renasight_Actual DESC 
LIMIT 5;
